title: Getting started
text: Getting started Download Scooby and sign in with your existing account. In the game selector, open Source Games → Half-Life 1 . All four games share the Half-Life 1 dashboard and this guide. Use Game version to choose Half-Life 1, Half-Life: Blue Shift, Half-Life: Opposing Force or Half-Life: Source. Match the installed edition. Use Start game to open the selected Steam title normally. Select OpenGL in the original game's video settings. Read the dashboard status. Half-Life and Opposing Force have verified native Windows builds. Blue Shift and Half-Life: Source are also supported editions in this collection. Module loading remains unavailable until the loader’s product access and package integration are connected. The dashboard also links to this guide, the full feature library and your selected edition's Scooby folder.

title: Menu settings Visuals Materials Profiles, language and Lua
text: Menu settings Visuals Choose supported entity categories, then adjust boxes, names, distance, skeletons, snaplines and radar. NPC labels describe the model; they do not report server-only health or faction information. Materials Open Visuals → Materials . Choose Tinted, Flat, Wireframe or Additive, then adjust visible and occluded colors. Animated chams offer Pulse, Color fade and Rainbow. Profiles, language and Lua Save your settings in a profile and assign hotkeys to controls you use often. The shared interface includes language packs with English fallback. Product-specific strings may remain in English. Use the bundled Half-Life Lua examples for supported local UI and session APIs.

title: Requirements
text: Requirements Original Half-Life on Steam , using the Windows 32-bit game and OpenGL renderer. The current original-game reference is Steam AppID 70, build 15961492. Compatibility is checked against the exact game files. The Half-Life 1 collection includes Half-Life: Blue Shift, Half-Life: Opposing Force and Half-Life: Source. Select the edition you have installed; its game files and support status remain specific to that edition. Half-Life and Opposing Force have passed their native Windows runtime checks. Blue Shift and Half-Life: Source are also supported editions in this collection. Follow the status shown in the loader before loading a module. Linux through Proton/Wine is being tested separately. Native Linux game binaries and software rendering are not covered by the current Windows OpenGL adapter.

title: Troubleshooting Which games share this guide? Which files should I use? The Load action is unavailable Missing text, fonts or Lua pages Features stop after leaving a map Need more help?
text: Troubleshooting Which games share this guide? Half-Life 1, Half-Life: Blue Shift, Half-Life: Opposing Force and Half-Life: Source belong to the same Half-Life 1 collection in Scooby. Use the version dropdown to match your installed edition. Which files should I use? Half-Life 1, Blue Shift, Opposing Force and Half-Life: Source are supported editions. Select your installed game and use its matching files. Sharing the product page does not make edition-specific game files interchangeable. The Load action is unavailable The original Windows campaign package has passed its runtime checks. Authenticated loader package integration is still pending. A DLL in the distribution folder is not a released loading option. Missing text, fonts or Lua pages Keep the matching module, fonts, languages and Lua assets together. Keep your writable profiles separate from the package and preserve them when updating. Features stop after leaving a map Session-bound visuals clear when their supported local game session ends. Load a supported local map and check the status before enabling features again. Need more help? Include the selected edition, Steam build, renderer and loader status when contacting support. Never include passwords or access keys.

title: Getting started
text: Getting started Get a free key or use your existing paid account, then download the loader and sign in. Select Left 4 Dead . Every valid free-key and paid session includes this product. Click Start Game , then choose Left 4 Dead 1 or Left 4 Dead 2 . Wait for the game's menu. The dashboard marks each running game and selects the newly detected game. If both are open, use the dropdown to choose the target. Press Load . The loader downloads verified runtime files and languages, then loads the x86 DLL into the selected game. Start a local single-player map and press Insert . Remote server features stay suspended. The menu key is configurable in Settings; Insert remains available. See troubleshooting if the menu does not appear.

title: Menu settings
text: Menu settings Press Insert to open the menu. Combat contains separate Rage and Legit profiles; Visuals contains ESP, infected colors, chams and pickups; World contains materials and view settings. Movement, Lua and Settings are under Misc. Set feature hotkeys through the gear controls; aim and trigger keys use the delayed key capture. Scale text, the menu and overlays independently, and choose from 23 language catalogs. Save profiles in Settings > Configs. The two games have separate user data. Use Lua > Scripts or Editor to run examples. API docs opens a selectable snippet guide. Folders Runtime assets are installed directly into C:\scooby\L4D\L4D1 and C:\scooby\L4D\L4D2 , with fonts, languages, scripts and docs directly inside each. There is no extra assets folder. User profiles and edited scripts live under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Scooby\L4DDebug\l4d1 or l4d2 . Downloaded DLL/helper versions are cached separately. L4D Lua API and examples →

title: Requirements
text: Requirements A Windows installation of Left 4 Dead 1 or Left 4 Dead 2 on Steam, using the supported 32-bit game build. The current Scooby Loader, with a valid free-key session or paid sign-in. Microsoft Visual C++ runtimes: x64 for the loader and x86 for the game module/helper . Rendering Direct3D 9 is the verified Windows path. Vulkan/DXVK depends on the game installation. The OpenGL UI preview is supported separately; stock Windows L4D does not provide a native OpenGL game renderer. Adapters check the installed game binaries before enabling hooks. A game update may require a matching Scooby update.

title: Troubleshooting
text: Troubleshooting The wrong game is selected Choose Left 4 Dead 1 or 2 in the dashboard dropdown. Detection checks left4dead.exe and left4dead2.exe once per second. When both are running, your selection is preserved. The menu does not appear Start the game from the loader, wait for the main menu, and press Insert after loading. Restart the game before loading the DLL again. Unsupported game binary versions leave hooks disabled. Features are inactive Use a local single-player map. Remote servers, demo playback, missing player data and loading screens suspend gameplay features. Enable the feature and check its hotkey mode. Download or runtime error Check your network connection, disk space and folder permissions. Install both x64 and x86 VC++ runtimes. Retry Load to re-check hashes and replace missing runtime assets. A failed verification does not start the helper. Text or scripts are missing Check the selected game's flat asset folder for languages , fonts , docs and l4d_pages.lua . Keep the current module and asset package together.

title: Troubleshooting
text: Troubleshooting The loader says Part I is not running Make sure the game itself has opened, not just Steam or a launcher. The loader detects tlou-i.exe . Wait for startup to finish and check the selected edition is Part I. The menu does not appear Wait for a rendered game scene and press F1 or Insert. If an older DLL is already loaded, close the game normally, reopen it and load the current version. Do not repeatedly load different builds into the same process. A download could not be verified Retry after checking the connection. If the release is being updated, wait for the DLL and matching manifests to finish publishing. The loader rejects a mismatched or incomplete module. ESP, weapon or self controls are unavailable Load a save and enter gameplay. Some features require a loaded player, camera, weapon or nearby entities. Read the disabled control’s explanation. If the game has updated, a matching module may be needed; a visible checkbox alone does not prove that a binding is available. Spawning an NPC or infected is unavailable Characters require resources from the current level. The catalog does not guarantee that every archetype can be spawned in every scene. Reset settings Close Part I before using Reset Settings in the dashboard. This prevents the running game from saving an old config over your reset. Back up profiles you want to keep.

title: First Time Setup
text: First Time Setup When installing Scooby for the first time, follow these steps: Step 1: Download Head over to scoobymenu.cc and click the download button to get the Scooby Installer. Make sure your anti-virus is turned off. Step 2: Extract & Run Extract the files into any folder. After that, run the .exe as an administrator. This ensures the launcher will run successfully. Step 3: Install Requirements Required Software: VC Runtimes: https://www.techpowerup.com/download/visual-c-redistributable-runtime-package-all-in-one/ DirectX: https://www.microsoft.com/en-gb/download/details.aspx?id=6812 Make sure you have your graphics drivers up to date. Step 4: Inject Load up GTA and wait for it to be on the main menu or in story mode. Then go back to the launcher, get a free license, and follow the steps. When you have acquired your free license, click Inject . This should inject the menu into the game. Then press Insert to open the menu - congratulations, you're done!

title: How To Host Public Sessions with Scooby (BE Disabled)
text: How To Host Public Sessions with Scooby (BE Disabled) Getting a public lobby to fill up is not just luck - it comes down to a handful of factors you can actually control. This guide covers what makes players join your session and what to do when nobody shows up. Everything here assumes you have launched GTA 5 with BattlEye disabled in the Rockstar Launcher settings, which is required for Scooby. If you have not done that yet, see First Time Setup . There are four factors behind a lobby that actually fills: your NAT type, your aim type, the region and time you host in, and a fair amount of luck. 1. NAT Type Your NAT type affects how easily other players can connect to your lobby. Open NAT - best results for hosting Moderate NAT - usually works fine Strict NAT - may reduce player joins and connectivity Important things to know: NAT type is normally controlled by your router and your ISP , not by the game. Some tools and scripts offer NAT spoofing, which presents a different NAT type to GTA Online. Results vary a lot and it does not work the same for every player. If you consistently struggle to attract players, check your NAT type and confirm your ISP is not putting you behind CGNAT (see below). 2. Aim Type Your aim setting decides which pool of players can even match with you. Free Aim - largest player pool on PC, attracts the most players Partial Aim Assist - still a decent number of players Full Aim Assist - smallest player pool on PC, expect fewer joins For the highest chance of filling a lobby, start with Free Aim . 3. Region and Timing Timing matters as much as the region itself. Aim for hours when people are: Getting home from work Finishing school Already gaming during the evening Good windows to try: North America, evenings Europe, evenings Weekends beat weekday mornings by a wide margin If one region is quiet, switch to another and try again. 4. Luck Sometimes everything is set up perfectly and the lobby still will not fill. You can host a session that fills instantly, then host the exact same session 30 minutes later and get nobody. GTA Online matchmaking is unpredictable, so persistence is part of the process. Bonus: Check for CGNAT Some ISPs place customers behind Carrier Grade NAT (CGNAT) , which shares one public IP between many customers. This can hurt your connectivity, your matchmaking and your hosting reliability. Contact your ISP Ask whether your connection is behind CGNAT Request a public IPv4 address if they offer one Bonus: Use a VPN A VPN can sometimes improve how visible you are in matchmaking. Best practice: Connect to a VPN server in a densely populated area Match your VPN region to the audience you are trying to attract Locations players commonly report good results with: New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, London, Frankfurt . Results vary, but busy metro areas generally give better lobby population. Checklist - you have done everything right if: Session advertising is enabled You are on Open or Moderate NAT You picked the right Aim Type (Free Aim fills fastest) You chose an active region and a busy time of day You confirmed you are not behind CGNAT Still Alone? Be patient. Try different combinations, restart the session, switch regions and keep experimenting. An empty lobby after one attempt does not mean your setup is wrong. If All Else Fails - Get Friends to Join First A lobby that already has a few players inside attracts far more players than an empty one. Once the first few people arrive, GTA Online matchmaking tends to do the rest. You can also turn on Player Magnet in the Network tab to help pull players in. In short: hosting is a combination of NAT type, aim type, region, ISP quality and a little bit of luck .

title: Money Making Methods
text: Money Making Methods Within the Scooby menu there are many ways to make money if you don't want to do it legitimately. Heist Method Make sure to enable Solo Hosting in the Recovery tab. This lets you do heists that require more than 1 person. Head to the Heists tab, set up your heist accordingly, and start it. When the heist starts, click Insta Finish to end it immediately - you'll receive 100% of the cut! Casino Method Head to the casino and enable Manipulate Slot Machines in the Recovery > Casino option. Go to the slots, bet the max, and you'll hit the jackpot! Disable the option, force yourself to fail a slot, then turn it back on and repeat. Business Method Head to the Business tab on the menu and find the Fill Supplies button. Your supplies will be maxed out, ready for you to sell!

title: Modding Outfits
text: Modding Outfits Modding outfits with Scooby is very simple! The menu includes a saved outfits section. Using Shared Outfits To use other people's saved outfits, find the file they share (many outfits can be found in the Scooby Discord) and save it to: C:\scooby\GTA5\outfits When you load in-game, use the menu to navigate to the outfits section and you will find the modded outfits there! Creating Your Own Outfits You can also mod outfits yourself! Head to the Outfit Editor in the Scooby menu. You can change the numbers on your character's clothing, and when you've found your perfect outfit, save it!

title: Troubleshooting
text: Troubleshooting Here are solutions to common issues you may encounter: Failed to allocate memory in target process Head to your Rockstar Launcher, click on Settings, and disable BattlEye . This will fix the issue. Please return to Grand Theft Auto V (Black Screen) You must inject the menu during the loading screen. This message means the game is signifying you're going back to story mode. BattlEye is required to play GTA V Online Same solution - inject the menu during the loading screen, not when you're already in the game. Black screen with an error message Restart your game without opening Scooby and go to story mode before injecting. Frame Generator is now supported , so you no longer need to turn it off. Failed to write process memory Turn off BattlEye in the Rockstar Launcher settings. Launcher, free key & injection troubleshooting Follow this guide if the launcher closes after opening, the free key website is unreachable, injection fails, or injection succeeds but the menu does not work in game. Check your connection. Try a VPN, then retry the website or launcher. Your network or ISP may be blocking the connection. Clear the cache if the launcher still closes or injection fails. Close Scooby, delete the C:\scooby folder, then restart Scooby and try again. If injection still fails, check whether antivirus is blocking the loader. Follow the Antivirus & Download FAQ for the next steps. If only the free key website is affected, you do not need to reset the launcher cache. If the issue continues, contact support with the error message and the steps you have tried. Not listed here? See Universal Troubleshooting in the General tab - it covers "Failed to inject module", Auth Failed, crashing on inject, BattlEye kicks and the Scooby folder going missing. If Windows is flagging or deleting the loader, start with the Antivirus & Download FAQ .

title: Modding Vehicles
text: Modding Vehicles Modding vehicles with Scooby is also very simple! Creating Modded Vehicles Open the menu and head to the Vehicles icon, then click Vehicle Editor at the bottom. This will allow you to mod your vehicle. To save it, head to Saved Vehicles, click Save Vehicle, name it, and save! Using Shared Vehicles Similar to outfits, you can use others' saved vehicles. Head to the Discord, find the vehicles thread, and download a file you want. Then drop it into: C:\scooby\GTA5\vehicles

title: How to Inject
text: How to Inject Timing is the single biggest factor in whether the injection works. Do it at the right moment and it is reliable every time. Best way to inject Inject at the FiveM main menu , or while the server is loading its resources and assets (the loading screen you get after picking a server). This is the most reliable point and the method we recommend. Step by step Open the Scooby loader and sign in Select FiveM Launch FiveM Click Inject at the main menu , or once you have joined a server and it is loading resources/assets Wait for Scooby to finish loading, then open the menu Already in a server? You can still inject while you are already in a server and in game - it is supported and it works. The main menu / resource loading screen is simply the more reliable moment, so use that when you can. Injection not working? Make sure your antivirus is fully disabled and the loader is excluded from Windows Defender , then try again from the main menu. If it still fails, work through Universal Troubleshooting in the General tab.

title: Money, items & weapons
text: Money, items & weapons Money, items, weapons, and rewards depend on the server you are playing on. There is no universal trigger that works on every server. Reviewing server events Load into the server and wait for its resources to finish loading. Use the server dump feature, then review the dumped resources for events related to inventories, weapons, jobs, or rewards. Read the surrounding code to understand an event’s purpose and requirements. An event name alone does not tell you whether it will work. Why an event may not work Servers may validate these events on the server side. A request can be rejected if you do not meet the required conditions, such as being in the correct location, having the right job or permissions, or completing a task before claiming its reward. A server dump does not guarantee access to the server-side logic or reveal every validation check. Risk of a kick or ban Attempting to use a protected event may result in an immediate kick or ban, or may have no effect. Finding an event in a dump does not mean it is unprotected or safe to use. Server-specific support You are responsible for finding and understanding events for the server you use. Scooby does not provide server-specific money, item, weapon, or reward triggers, and support cannot help you find working triggers or bypass a server’s protections.

title: Before Launching Scooby
text: Before Launching Scooby Red Dead Redemption 2 does not use BattlEye , so it does not matter whether you leave it on or off. Get these sorted before you launch anything: Make sure your graphics drivers are up to date Install all runtimes and DirectX runtimes - just choose to install them when running the Scooby Installer, then restart your PC afterwards Disable Windows Defender. Turn it off normally - do not use Sordum / Defender Control , it causes issues for some people and turning Defender off manually removes that possibility of errors If you have any third-party antivirus installed (Norton, Avast, Malwarebytes, etc.) you need to uninstall it. These still cause issues even when they are "off"

title: Crashing? Switch to DX12
text: Crashing? Switch to DX12 IF YOU ARE CRASHING THEN YOU NEED TO SWITCH FROM VULKAN TO DX12 In Red Dead Redemption 2, open Settings → Graphics and scroll down to Advanced Graphics . Change Graphics API from Vulkan to DX12 , then apply the change and restart the game.

title: Features Not Working
text: Features Not Working If Scooby loads but none of the features do anything , that almost always means one thing: CS2 HAS BEEN UPDATED AND SCOOBY NEEDS UPDATING TO MATCH Valve patches CS2 regularly, and every patch moves things around internally. Until Scooby is rebuilt against the new version, the menu will open but the features will not work. How long does an update take? It varies. Sometimes it is within an hour of the CS2 update, sometimes a day , sometimes up to about five days - realistically, whenever we have time to get to it. The CS2 menu is completely free , so it sits behind the paid products in the queue. We would rather be straight with you about that than promise a turnaround we cannot always hit. What to do in the meantime There is nothing to fix on your end - reinstalling will not help. Check the Discord for the current status, and update the loader once the new build is announced.

title: Getting started
text: Getting started Scooby GMOD uses a free key and requires Garry's Mod on Windows with Steam's x86-64 branch selected. Load Scooby while the game is at the main menu. Open the GMOD product page , choose Get Free Key , and follow the key steps. See Getting a Free Key for help. Download Scooby . In your Steam Library , right-click Garry's Mod and open Properties → Game Versions & Betas . Select x86-64 , then wait for Steam to finish updating the game. Launch Garry's Mod and wait at the main menu . Load Scooby from the loader while you are still at the main menu , before joining a server or loading a map. Once Scooby is loaded, press Insert or F2 to open the menu.

title: Connection or SSL Errors
text: Connection or SSL Errors If you get connection errors trying to load the website or the loader, it is because your ISP is blocking the connection to the servers. USE A VPN Cloudflare is usually good for most users, or you can use Proton . If you are still getting errors while connected to a VPN, it probably means you need to use a better VPN.

title: Crashing Solutions
text: Crashing Solutions Work through these in order - they resolve the overwhelming majority of crashes: Delete C:\scooby . Do this after every Scooby update to avoid conflicts with your old settings Do not use third-party antivirus software (Norton, Avast, Malwarebytes, etc.) Turn off Windows Defender. Avoid Defender Control - just turn it off normally and avoid any issues DC may cause Make sure DirectX runtimes and C++ runtimes are installed Make sure your graphics drivers are up to date Try using a VPN , and make sure it has no built-in antivirus or anti-malware settings. Cloudflare works for most users Make sure Date & Time is synced in Windows settings If all of the above fails and you are still crashing, it is probably your user permissions - create a new Windows user with admin rights Free users Make sure you are following the injection instructions properly . Almost every issue comes from skipping steps. The guides exist for a reason - if you want to play without the restrictions, the Premium Plus version gives you access to everything. Otherwise, use the limited free version as documented.

title: Antivirus & Download FAQ
text: Antivirus & Download FAQ The most common questions people ask before they even get the loader running. Read these first if Windows is blocking or removing your download. Why is Scooby flagged as a virus? It is most commonly known as a false positive , which means your PC may automatically flag the mod menu as malware because it doesn't recognise the file or its intentions. This happens due to the way mod menus are developed, not necessarily because they are malicious. How can I download the loader? Simply disable Real-time Protection in Windows Security. You may also need to temporarily disable your browser's Safe Browsing or Safe Search feature if it prevents the download. Recommended browsers are Chrome and Firefox . Why does the Scooby loader delete itself after some time? This usually happens because the loader hasn't been added as an exclusion in Windows Defender. When Real-time Protection is re-enabled, Windows Defender may automatically remove the loader. To prevent this, open Windows Security and go to: Virus & threat protection → Manage settings → Add or remove exclusions → Add an exclusion Select the Scooby loader. Once it has been added as an exclusion, Windows Defender should no longer remove it automatically.

title: Use Scooby on Linux & Mac
text: Use Scooby on Linux & Mac Compatibility preview. Game support is still being tested. What works and what to expect . 1. Get ready 2. Choose your setup 3. Start playing Get help 1. Get ready Download and extract Scooby. Get Scooby-compatibility.zip from Scooby downloads and extract the whole ZIP. Keep all the files together. If you only see the Windows installer, ask support for the compatibility preview . Check your game works first. Open the Windows version of your game through its usual launcher at least once. It needs to work on its own before you add Scooby. Open a terminal in the extracted folder. Open the folder containing linux , right-click an empty area and choose Open in Terminal , if your file manager offers it. New to the terminal? Start here A terminal lets you run the short commands in this guide. On Steam Deck, use Desktop Mode and open Konsole . Paste a command with Ctrl + Shift + V , then press Enter . Keep the terminal in the extracted folder that contains linux . If you opened it elsewhere, type cd followed by that folder's full path in quotes, then press Enter. Run Scooby as your normal user, without sudo . The launch scripts need Python 3.10 or newer . Check with this command: python3 --version A result such as Python 3.12.3 is fine. If Python is missing or older than 3.10, install it using your system's supported package manager. 2. Choose your setup Open the option that matches how you start your game. You only need to follow one. Linux with Steam I launch my game from my Steam library. Install Protontricks. Follow the official installation instructions . Installed it through Discover or as a Flatpak? Use the Steam Deck / Flatpak steps instead. Start your game once with Proton. In Steam, open the game's Properties → Compatibility , select the Proton version you use for the Windows game, then launch it. Find your game number. Run this command. Look for your game in the list; the number next to it is its App ID . protontricks -l Your game's App ID Paste the number next to your game. Your launch command will update below. Replace APPID in the command below with the number next to your game. Open Scooby. Copy the command below into your terminal and press Enter. sh linux/launch.sh --runner proton --appid APPID The Scooby sign-in window should open. Then continue to Start playing . Keep using your game's usual Steam entry. Adding Scooby as a separate non-Steam game can put it in the wrong Windows environment. Advanced: I use a custom Steam data folder Only use this if you changed the game's Steam compatdata location. Replace the path with the folder containing pfx , not pfx itself. sh linux/launch.sh --runner proton --appid APPID --compat-data "/path/to/compatdata/APPID" The App ID field fills in the game number. You still need to replace the example folder path. Steam Deck / Flatpak I use a Steam Deck, or installed Protontricks through Flatpak. Use Desktop Mode. On Steam Deck, open Discover , search for Protontricks and install it. Leave SteamOS in its normal read-only state. Start the Windows game once through Steam. Use its usual Proton version. Keep the extracted Scooby folder open in your terminal. Find your game's App ID. Run this command and find the number next to your game. flatpak run com.github.Matoking.protontricks -l Your game's App ID Paste the number next to your game. Your launch command will update below. Replace APPID in the command below with the number next to your game. Open Scooby. Copy this command into the terminal and press Enter. sh linux/launch.sh --runner proton --flatpak --appid APPID When the sign-in window appears, continue to Start playing . Use Desktop Mode with a mouse or trackpad for now. Game Mode, controller navigation and suspend/resume are not yet verified. My game is on an SD card or another drive Protontricks may need permission to access that Steam library. Follow its Flatpak access instructions . The Scooby launcher already grants access to its own bin folder for each run. Linux with Lutris / Wine I use Lutris, Rockstar Games Launcher or another Wine setup. Using Lutris? You can set up a shortcut. Scooby needs the same Windows folder and Wine version as your game. Open your game's configuration in Lutris. Note the Wine prefix and Wine version . The prefix is the folder containing the game's Windows files. Add a locally installed game. Name it Scooby, choose the Wine runner, and select linux/bin/ScoobyLoader.exe from your extracted package. Match the two settings. Use the exact same Wine prefix and Wine version as your game. Leave the bundled DLL files beside ScoobyLoader.exe . Save and launch Scooby. Once the sign-in window opens, continue to Start playing . I use Wine directly, without Lutris Replace both paths with your game's Wine executable and existing prefix folder. Keep the quotes around the paths. sh linux/launch.sh --runner wine --wine "/path/to/wine" --prefix "/path/to/game-prefix" The prefix is the folder containing drive_c . It must already be set up and support 64-bit Windows apps. The launcher does not create or repair it. Do not use plain Wine on a Steam Proton prefix. Mac I have a Mac-compatible Wine setup for my Windows game. Mac support is unverified . You need Python 3.10+ and a Mac-compatible Wine version that runs Windows x64 apps. On Apple silicon, that Wine distribution must also provide the required translation and graphics support. Confirm your Windows game works first. Find the Wine executable and prefix used by that game. Open Terminal in the extracted Scooby folder. Replace both example paths, then run: sh linux/mac/launch.command --wine "/absolute/path/to/wine" --prefix "/absolute/path/to/game-prefix" Continue to Start playing if the sign-in window opens. Using CrossOver? Follow its instructions to run Scooby in the same bottle as your game. This script does not configure CrossOver bottles automatically. Double-clicking the script without the paths above will not set it up. Proton is Linux-only. 3. Start playing Sign in to Scooby. Use your account or follow the free-key guide . Open your game as usual. Use the Steam or Lutris entry you set up above. Follow your game's loading steps. Open its Scooby guide to check when to load the menu. Timing and game support vary. Next time: use the same launch command or Lutris shortcut. Close both the game and Scooby before changing Wine or Proton versions. Something not working? Pick the problem you see. “File not found” or the launch script will not open Open the extracted folder that contains linux , then open a terminal there. Check that linux/bin/ScoobyLoader.exe exists. Extract the whole compatibility ZIP again if files are missing; the standard Windows installer does not include these scripts. “Python not found” or “Runner not found” Check python3 --version ; you need 3.10 or newer. For Steam, install Protontricks. If you installed it through Discover or Flatpak, follow the Flatpak steps . For Wine, check the Wine executable path. Scooby cannot find my game Run the Windows version of the game and check your App ID. In Lutris, Scooby and the game must share the exact same Wine prefix and Wine version . A native Linux game cannot load the Windows menu. If these match, the game may still be incompatible with this preview. The window is blank, or text is missing Keep all the runtime DLLs beside the loader and check that your game works with the selected runner. For missing Segoe UI text, add a licensed copy of segoeui.ttf to the same prefix's drive_c/windows/Fonts folder, then restart Scooby. A graphics error may need help with your Wine/Proton setup. I need to update Scooby or find my settings Close Scooby, then download and extract the latest compatibility package. Updates are manual; an old package can be blocked by a required minimum version. Your settings are inside the game's prefix at drive_c/scooby (the Windows path C:\scooby ). Each prefix has separate data. If changing prefixes causes an HWID mismatch, follow the HWID reset guide . The game is running slowly Compare the game with and without Scooby using the same settings. Performance depends on your graphics drivers, Wine/Proton version and enabled menu features. Close both apps before testing a different runner, and keep the game and loader on the same version. I need more help / want to check my setup Add --diagnose to the end of your launch command. It prints a setup report without opening Scooby. This checks local files and launch options; it does not prove that login, graphics, Steam/Flatpak access or game loading will work. Send Scooby support your OS, game, Wine/Proton version and exact error. Remove private details from reports and never share passwords or license keys. What works and what to expect This package runs the Windows x64 loader through Wine or Proton. Login, graphics and in-game loading still need testing on real Linux, Steam Deck and Mac systems. No game is certified yet; the loader opening does not guarantee that its menu will work. Windows-only cleaner, identifier and kernel-driver tools are unavailable. Native Linux/Mac games cannot load Windows DLLs. Game and anti-cheat restrictions still apply.

title: Universal Troubleshooting
text: Universal Troubleshooting Fixes for the specific errors people hit most often. This list is updated regularly - check back after an update before opening a ticket. Not injecting Make sure you have disabled BattlEye in the Rockstar Launcher. If you launch through Steam or Epic , disable it there too with the launch argument -nobattleye Exclude the Scooby application and its folder in Documents from Windows Defender. Third-party antivirus can still cause issues even when fully disabled Run Scooby as Administrator Delete the Scooby folder in your C:\ drive Remove OneDrive - it can cause permission issues in the Documents folder Verify your system files: open CMD as Administrator and run sfc /scannow Make sure your C: drive and Scooby folder have Full Control in their Properties → Security settings "Failed to inject module. Try disabling your Anti-Virus." A few different things cause this error. Follow these steps correctly and it should stop appearing: Make sure you are using the correct Windows user profile with Administrator privileges , and always run the Scooby loader as Administrator Move the Scooby loader to your Desktop , then add both the loader and your C: drive folder to your antivirus exclusions If you have OneDrive enabled, fully unlink and uninstall it You can tell OneDrive is getting in the way if you can't find the Scooby folder in your normal Documents folder , or if the path shown in your antivirus exclusions contains "OneDrive" . Crashing on inject Exclude the Scooby application and its folder in Documents from Windows Defender. Third-party antivirus can still cause issues even when fully disabled Check the log to see if you are getting Failed to Find Patterns - if so, follow the Failed to Find Patterns guide in our Discord Make sure HDR is disabled in Windows Display Settings Verify your GTA game files Delete the Scooby folder in your C:\ drive Verify your system files: open CMD as Administrator and run sfc /scannow Loader not opening, or "Auth Failed" error Use a VPN - https://one.one.one.one/ Disable or remove any third-party antivirus "GTA detected a fatal error" Most of the time this is not caused by Scooby , but by faulty game files or something else on your system. Look up the specific error code shown (for example ERR_GFX_STATE ) - it will point you to the actual cause. Subscribed scripts not showing up Use a VPN - https://one.one.one.one/ Why am I getting desync-kicked by BattlEye while using Scooby? The reason for the desync-kick is that you are joining public sessions as a non-host , which causes BattlEye to remove you from the session. This happens because you are playing GTA Online with BattlEye disabled while other players have it enabled . To prevent it, start your own sessions as the host. You will then be able to play normally with non-modders who have BattlEye enabled. In the menu, go to: Session Tab → Session Starter → Invite-Only Session or New Public Session If you want other players to join, enable the Advertise Session function in the host toolkit, or simply invite your friends. See How To Host Public Sessions with Scooby for the full walkthrough. We also have a BattlEye bypass that lets you join anyone, including random public sessions - all the information on that is on the GTA 5 product page . Getting BattlEye kicked even without Scooby running You most likely joined a public lobby where you were not the host and got kicked by BattlEye while using Scooby. You will need to wait 12-24 hours for the kick to go away. Until then, stick to lobbies where you are the host , or where another BattlEye-disabled player is the host. Scooby folder not in Documents Check your C:\ drive for it. It falls back there if permissions fail in Documents - usually because of OneDrive.
